title: Warning on law practice details misused to smuggle contraband into prisons
summary: The VLSB+C warns that people are using law practices' names and letterheads to disguise contraband as legal mail sent into prisons. It recommends steps to make genuine legal mail easy to verify.
what_changes: Corrections Victoria has intercepted contraband packaged as legal mail using law practices' details, with no evidence the practices knew.
Recommends consistent letterhead, packaging, return address and a practice-specific identifier on mail to people in custody.
Recommends keeping accurate records of items sent to clients in custody and using tamper-proof packaging where practical.
Practices that learn their details may have been misused are expected to contact Corrections Victoria directly.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian law practices that send legal mail to clients in custody.

history.event: VLSB+C warned that law practice details are being misused to smuggle contraband into prisons as legal mail.
